description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for creating responses and events for 'ModifyThing' commands in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested factory interfaces for generating command responses and events, such as 'created' or 'modified', and error responses like 'thing not accessible' or 'not modifiable'.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for producing command responses and events related to 'ModifyThing' commands.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for constructing 'ModifyThingResponse' objects indicating the result of a 'ModifyThing' command, such as creation, modification, or specific error conditions.

classes.name: ModifyThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events ('ThingCreated' or 'ThingModified') triggered by 'ModifyThing' commands.
